description: Every specimen J-lens covector and window-1 final-position readout during the canonical training run.

conventions.ids: 1-based character ids; time index k+1 is after k updates, including k=0
conventions.tensors: column-major {shape,data}; Float64 computation, five significant digits on export
conventions.jacobian: J = mean over windows and sources of SUM over causal targets K; J_L=I
conventions.last_probs: last_probs[character,depth,k+1]; last input position T of training window 1
conventions.loss: loss[k+1] is the full-batch cross-entropy after k updates

provenance.theta0: stored Float64 theta0; no random reinitialisation
